instructions: Pour the milk into a medium saucepan, add the salt and bring it to a simmer over medium heat, about 4 minutes. You'll see small bubbles at the edges. Keep an eye on it so it doesn't boil over.
Meanwhile, rinse the berries. Hull and slice the strawberries.
Turn the heat to low. Pour in the Cream of Wheat in a slow stream while you whisk.
Switch to a spoon and stir for 2 to 3 minutes, until it's thick and bubbling gently.
Take the pan off the heat and let it sit for 1 minute. It thickens a little more as it sits.
Spoon the cereal into 4 bowls. Serve topped with the strawberries and blueberries.
method_notes: Emily Laurae's stovetop method (simmer the liquid, whisk in the cereal, stir 2 to 3 minutes) is the lead, with the Cream of Wheat site's berries-and-milk bowl as the match for the topping. Neither page has a rating bar high enough. The cereal is 2/3 cup to 4 cups milk, the lead's ratio. No sugar is added; the berries sweeten it.
